name: GeoAgent Optimizer Lite
author: Todij AI Technology

sections.description:
Traditional SEO is evolving into GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).

GeoAgent Optimizer Lite is an essential tool designed to make your WordPress site fully compatible with modern AI bots like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google Gemini. By structuring your content and managing bot crawl signals, this plugin ensures that Large Language Models (LLMs) can easily discover, read, and cite your website as a reliable source in their generated answers.

🚀 Core Features (Lite Version)
* Dynamic Agent-Native llms.txt: Automatically generates an autonomous list of your allowed posts and pages specifically for AI agents, completely replacing static file needs.
* Page/Post Level AI Control: Granular control via a sidebar Meta Box. Choose whether to allow AI training, block RAG indexing, or completely hide specific posts from autonomous bots.
* AI Content Signals (HTTP Headers): Inject Content-Signal headers (ai-train, search, ai-input) seamlessly to manage ethical data fetching policies.
* Markdown Engine (Server Bypass): Converts your HTML content into clean, token-efficient Markdown on-the-fly when requested by agents using the Accept: text/markdown header.
* Live AI Traffic Monitor: A lightweight dashboard widget that tracks real-time hits from bots like ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended (Last 25 hits).
* Virtual XML Sitemap: Generates a clean, AI-focused sitemap fallback at /sitemap.xml without creating physical files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/geoagent-optimizer-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘GeoAgent’ menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure your AI compatibility settings.
  4. Open any Post or Page to set granular AI read permissions using the GeoAgent Content Signals Meta Box on the right sidebar.
sections.faq:
Does this replace my SEO plugin?

No. GeoAgent Optimizer is designed to work alongside traditional SEO plugins (like Yoast or RankMath). While they focus on Google Search, this plugin focuses on ChatGPT, Claude, and Generative AI Engines.

What does the Page/Post Level Control do?

It allows you to specify exactly how AI models treat specific articles. You can allow them to read it for answers, but block them from using your content to train their long-term models (ai-train=no).
